name: NatureBench
protocol: Source export protocol; row-level protocol details are preserved when available.

explanation.en: The score is the percentage of the 90 tasks on which the agent's method beats the published state of the art by a normalized margin above 0.1.
explanation.zh: 分数是 agent 的方法在归一化差距大于 0.1 的意义上超过论文已发表 SOTA 的任务占 90 个任务的百分比。

summary.en: NatureBench tests research agents on containerized tasks drawn from Nature-family papers, requiring a method that surpasses the published state of the art.
summary.zh: NatureBench 用取自 Nature 系列论文的容器化任务评估 research agent，要求给出超过已发表 SOTA 的方法。

task_format.en: With web search disabled and a matched GPU, the agent develops and runs a method for one of 90 tasks and is scored on whether it exceeds the published state of the art.
task_format.zh: 在关闭联网搜索、配备匹配 GPU 的条件下，agent 为 90 个任务之一开发并运行方法，按是否超过已发表 SOTA 评分。
